entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. I've been on hold for ten minutes. I want to return this piece of junk I bought!
Hello, thank you for your patience. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. I can certainly help you with a return today. To get started, could I have your order number?
It's VF987654. And your sizing chart is a complete lie. This is ridiculous. I want my money back now.

Okay, I'm pulling that up now... I see the ClubFit Jersey, delivered on January 12th. I can definitely look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand the situation, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?

What's the issue? The issue is it's the wrong size! I ordered a medium, and this thing is so tight I can barely get it on. This jersey is useless to me. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?
I understand your frustration, and there's no need to speak to a manager, I can handle this for you. I'm very sorry to hear the jersey was too tight and didn't fit as you expected.
Sorry doesn't fix it! I'm one click away from leaving a review that will make sure no one ever buys from you again. So what are you going to do?

I can absolutely fix this. Since you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window for apparel, we can definitely process this for you. Would you prefer an exchange for a larger size, or a full refund back to your original payment method?
Wait, a full refund? You're not going to hit me with some 'restocking fee' or make me pay to ship it back?

Not at all. Since the sizing was the issue, we'll cover the return shipping completely. I am generating a prepaid shipping label and sending it to the email address on file right now. You should see it in the next minute or two. Just print that out, and you can send the jersey back for a full refund.
Oh. Okay, I just got the email. Well... that's actually what I wanted. Thank you.
You are very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Was there anything else I could help with today?
No, that's it. Thanks for your help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great rest of your day.
